hash-checked: Measured bytes match a specified commitment. A portable derivative hash is distinct from the original-byte commitment.
newly executed: New execution during this recovery. Only bounded offline evidence verification/analysis and archival inspection occurred; zero new scientific cells, generation, training, solver/toolchain runs.
null: Unavailable or unmeasured value, with reason. CSV empty cells correspond to JSON null; zero is used only for an observed count or explicitly scoped execution count.
recomputed: A statistic or integrity check computed now from retained artifacts, preserving its original population/protocol.
recovered: Actual artifact bytes located/copied with provenance; scientific validity is not implied.
replayed: Historical procedure or effect executed again. No historical admissions or scientific experiments were replayed here.
reported: A source states a value; no underlying measurement is thereby verified.
